definitions.short: a stone (as if pressed hard or to a point); (by implication, of use) a knife
definitions.full: H6864. tsor II. צֹר noun [masculine] id.; — ׳צ used as knife Exod 4:25 ; in compare, מִצ חָזָק ׳כְּשָׁמִיר Ezek 3:9 ; plural צֻרִים חַרְכוֺת Josh 5:2-3 , knives of flint. — חַרְכּוֺ צזּר Psa 89:44 is dubious, ׳צ usually taken as = צֹר , and then either flint of his sword (i.e. sword sharp as flint, Bae), or edge (like flint) of his sword (most); We leaves untranslated; הַצֻּדִים חֶלְקַת 2Sam 2:16 see I. חֶלְקָה — Job 22:24 see I. צוּר below V. צור . I. צֹר .
